name: Can I prevent future drain clogs after a professional cleaning?

mainEntity.name: Can I prevent future drain clogs after a professional cleaning?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can take several steps to prevent future drain clogs after a professional cleaning. Avoiding pouring grease or coffee grounds down kitchen drains, using drain strainers in sinks and showers to catch hair and food particles, and properly disposing of non-flushable items are crucial. Regular maintenance, such as periodic flushing with hot water or using enzymatic drain cleaners (not chemical ones), can also help. CG Plumbing Solutions often provides recommendations tailored to your home's specific plumbing system and usage patterns, helping you implement effective preventative measures to extend the life of your drains and reduce future service calls.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent future clogs by avoiding grease, using drain strainers, and disposing of non-flushable items. Follow professional advice for ongoing maintenance.
